we have identified a mechanism for sequence to sequence working memory in RNNs and have shown how this mechanism is realized in a synthetic system.
we provide a detailed understanding for the mechanisms that allow a recurrent neural network to perform a working memory task.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to perform sequence-to-sequence working memory, the network must have a gating mechanism that allows for the information to be held in memory.
gating mechanisms are a natural architectural choice for RNNs to achieve the desired dynamical behavior required to perform working-memory related tasks.
gating is an important mechanism to achieve working memory, as it allows for the network to control the amount of information it is holding in its state.
